hooks.command: { echo "Available skills:"; find -L "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills" -name SKILL.md 2>/dev/null | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do name=$(sed -n 's/^name: *//p' "$f" | head -1); desc=$(sed -n 's/^description: *//p' "$f" | head -1); printf -- '- %s: %s\n' "$name" "$desc"; done; } | python -c "import json, sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': sys.stdin.read()}))"
